activate.description: Bring Files to the foreground without opening an item.

activate-direct.description: Foreground Files without opening a location or item.

prohibited: enumerating, opening, searching, moving, renaming, copying, deleting, tagging, or sharing files through UI automation
provider, location, folder, account, credential, or SMB interaction
claiming receipt or exact visibility from callback or launch acceptance
safety.uncertain_outcome: A launch or transfer may already have occurred. Inspect with the user and do not replay.

data_access: No Files contents, locations, providers, filenames, or metadata are read
data_sent: One explicit user-selected local regular file through AirDrop when requested
privacy.retention: No file content or Files UI data is committed. The AirDrop transport may retain a private snapshot only after uncertain delivery.
privacy.notes: The integration does not navigate to an exact Files path.
